channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Diamond Landscaping acquires Christensen Landscape Services
item.description: Christensen is Diamond's seventh acquisition since partnering with Kian Capital in 2021 and follows the platform’s recent acquisition of Arizona Outdoor Designs.

item.title: Agri-Fab introduces 50-inch Heavy Duty Lawn Sweeper
item.description: It also offers a large 26-cubic-foot capacity bag with flow-through technology that fills the bag completely.

item.title: The Aquatrols Company rolls out Precip Acres to Canadian dealers
item.description: Precip Acres is a water conservation soil surfactant that delivers a combination of hydration and infiltration across large acreage.

item.title: AlignOps BusyBusy adds new Resource Planning functionality
item.description: BusyBusy Resource Planning features drag-and-drop adjustments to project and task timelines as schedules change.

item.title: Exmark to offer suspended operator platform on Lazer Z S-Series
item.description: The Lazer Z S-Series is available with a 60-inch UltraCut Series 4 cutting deck and a Kawasaki FX801V engine.

item.title: Loftness Specialized Equipment to debut new stone crusher, tree saw attachment
item.description: The Stone Ax and Kwik Fall are both available to order starting May 1.

item.title: AlignOps FleetWatcher adds new dispatch module
item.description: The new dispatch experience allows users to see all scheduled jobs in one place, displaying orders, fulfilled requests and pending assignments together.

item.title: Motive adds new AI capabilities to its Workforce Management product
item.description: The new capabilities aim to give organizations a single place to track and manage critical workforce processes.

item.title: PRO Landscape+ releases AI Outdoor Living Designer
item.description: In addition to the AI Outdoor Living Designer, the company is introducing a new AI Paver Tool.

item.title: Isuzu starts national dealership graphics program with Wrapmate
item.description: At over Isuzu dealers nationwide, the program enables dealers to offer professionally produced vehicle wraps and graphics directly at the point of purchase.
